Grill is decent, customer support spends most of it's time trying to close the ticket, not resolving the problem or providing customer care.

Results.ReviewText: I have had a Weber charcoal grill for over thirty years. As some parts rust, I have looked into buying replacement parts, but the cost of these parts are so prohibitively expensive that it makes more sense to send the perfectly good kettle grill to the dump and buy a new one. I prefer keeping products out of the landfill for as long as possible, so would prefer fairly priced replacement parts over buying a completely new grill.
Results.Title: Replacement parts too costly

Results.ReviewText: So far so good.  I love my new grill.  I do wish the charcoal grate had smaller spacing though, as the smaller pieces of my lump charcoal fall right through.  Also, the charcoal scraper at the base doesn't quite spin all the way, so there is some that does not get scraped.  Not a huge deal, just something noticed.

Results.ReviewText:
This isn’t just a grill — it’s the king of charcoal cooking. With its iconic dome design and precision vents, the Weber 22" Kettle delivers perfect sears, slow-cooked briskets, and everything in between. Built like a tank, it handles the elements and years of use without blinking.

Simple to use, easy to clean, and endlessly versatile, it turns every cookout into a masterclass in fire and flavor.

Final Verdict: 10/10.
Classic. Reliable. Legendary.
The Weber Kettle doesn’t just cook — it creates legends.
Results.Title: A Backyard Legend

Results.ReviewText:
After reviewing many charcoal bbq’s, I finally decided on this one.
I thought I won the lottery! I went to my local Canadian Tire store to purchase this bbq. They said that they had one in stock, but when I went to get it, it wasn’t there. I asked a sales person where it was. He said that it shows it still in stock. For some reason it was in the clearance section, the box had been opened, but resealed. I asked if there was anything wrong with it if I could return it and they said absolutely. The regular price was $359.00 and it was marked down to $179.00. “Start The Car!” I bought it home and everything was perfect in the box. The only problem I had was installing the legs into the bbq, extremely tight fit. But I finally was able to get everything put together. I seasoned the bbq as per instructions, and made my first homemade bbq baked bean recipe. I added some mesquite wood chunks to the lump charcoal and it added a unique flavour to the beans. 
If you were to put some of these beans on your forehead,
your tongue would slap your eyeballs out of your head trying to get at it!
Results.Title: Great First Time Charcoal BBQ

Results.ReviewText: All you need for any of your grilling needs! Love ours!
Results.Title: Perfection

Results.ReviewText: This is my first kettle and I have to say I wish I had bought one years ago. The things you can do on this grill are amazing. You don’t need to buy an offset smoker or a pellet smoker…anything you want to grill or smoke can be done on the Weber Kettle. If you do t have one, do yourself a favor and go get it now. You won’t be sorry!
Results.Title: Simply Amazing

ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText:
Purchase this product last week and was very excited to get a quality BBQ that will last for years to come. I first noticed the product upon opening it that it had paint runs inside the cooking chamber. The next issue was the cooking grate was bent and would not fit on the kettle flat and I had to bend it back into shape. The most recent issue I've had after my second use is one of the handles on the metal grate broke off where it was soldered together.

It's really disappointing to see another company build a cheaply made "corner cutting" product and still changing a premium price for it under the pretence that it will last for years to come.
Results.Title: Poor quality control and cheap build material

Results.ReviewText: Used a couple times and works great.  Only concern was missing the screw for the side handle.  Thank God I have kept all screws for the last 20 years and had 1 that fit.  Other than that great quality and cooks nicely.
Results.Title: Nice Kettle

Results.ReviewText: The best charcoal bbq you can buy for a longterm use without worries.
Results.Title: Cant beat the best of the best...

Results.ReviewText: Worked well, more of a challenge with my use of it on the maiden voyage. Ambient temperature outdoors was -15C and I didn't calculate the wind appropriately, so only one charcoal basket stayed lit. Once I caught that, all worked well.
Results.Title: BBQ in the cold

Results.ReviewText: Great product. A lot of accessories to make grilling so fun experience
Results.Title: Great Product

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use. Great tasting food. Easy clean up. Love the cast iron skillet for smash burgers
Results.Title: Everyone  is a master chef

Results.ReviewText: Excellent bbq, mon deuxième, versatile, polyvalent.
Results.Title: Meilleures rapport qualité prix

Results.ReviewText: I have owned grills(cheap) for a long time.  The last one I bought broke recently and I decided to buy a Weber.  The attention to detail and the features are great.  When I consider that I have probably spent more than 600 dollars over the time on cheap grills I would have been better off just buying a Weber.  I am so pleasantly surprised with my purchase.  Oh, and get the Chimney Starter, total game changer.  Fill it with charcoal. place a piece of paper towel with some cooking oil on the grill, light it up and place the Chimney on it and wait 20 minutes, you will be glad you did!
Results.Title: Stop wasting money on cheap grills

Results.ReviewText: The lid will not even come close to seal tight as the hinge mechanism is broken. Smoke comes out of the sides. I've tried to adjust the hinge as best as I can but I simply can't make it work. Others on teh internet experience this exact same problem so I am not alone. I should have just gone with the Original - I need to throw out this junk now.
Results.Title: Lid won't close tight

Results.ReviewText: I use my grill at least 3 days a week and have had it just over a year. My only beef with it is the top screws that hold the handle on have rusted bu thta doesnt stop me from giving it a 5 star review. I love it and will by another when needed.
Results.Title: The Charcoal Grill Champ

Results.ReviewText: I bought my Master Touch four years ago. It was my first charcoal BBQ. After a few cooks on it, I learned how to use it. Also many YouTube and Instagram videos got me pointed in the right direction. The simplicity and efficiency of this kettle still makes me smile every time I take the cover off. I love my kettle!
Results.Title: Awesome BBQ

Results.ReviewText:
When assembling, we struggled with inserting the 3-paper thin leg-Tubes into its base. They are so thin, extreme care must be used to avoid bending or kinking these tubes. As a Federally Licensed Aircraft Mechanic, I easily spotted the lack of Engineering that went into the design of the Master-Touch Series!

As a result, the kettle itself is very unstable and feels flimsy when moving it around or even while scrubbing the Grill after use. I have serious reservations about its longevity. A typical example of Cost over Quality!  If I hadn't used it and saved the Box, I would have brought it back to the store!
Results.Title: Very Disappointed in Quality and Engineering!

Results.ReviewText: Absolutely incredible grill and incredible service from the Weber team!
Results.Title: Absolutely incredible grill and incredible service

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill... a replacement for one that was stolen.  I am impressed with the heavier grill and warming rack (which was damaged and replaced by Weber)
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText:
Our brand new Weber Grill came with a big dent on the rim of the cover lid so much so it would not seal the grill; Weber wanted a photograph of the dented grill cover to replace it which they did quickly.
When we tried to position the new grill on the newly purchased Grill Cart, it would not fit properly, The cover holder kept falling off;  the design of the grill and grill cart leaves something to be desired.
Results.Title: Dented Grill Cover.

Results.ReviewText: This is an update to my original review. Weber’s customer service is outstanding. They actually contacted me to resolve my issue, I never contacted them. They even overnighted the replacement parts at their cost. What more can I say, Weber cares about their customers.
Results.Title: Great customer service

14510601.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14510601.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate fits circular GBS grillware· Included Char-Rails make it easy to arrange charcoal· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Tuck-Away Lid Holder provides handy space to hang lid· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels.· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant and 2” taller· 10-year limited warranty
